decks.name: D1 Quintorius Spirits

slots.notes: D1 · replaces Seize the Spoils · tier 1 · $38.27 · Mana equal to an opponent's hand plus three cards off the top. It is the turn where Quintorius goes from grinding to winning.

D1 · replaces Primary Research · tier 1 · $10.54 · Every spell you cast from the graveyard is a card leaving the graveyard, so every one is also a Spirit. This is the deck's engine, not a value piece.
D1 · replaces Advanced Reconstruction · tier 2 · $7.52 · Exiles a spell out of the graveyard and copies it. Two Quintorius triggers and a free sorcery in one card.
D1 · replaces Ceaseless Conflict · tier 2 · $5.01 · Scales every combat instead of a five-mana spell that does not touch the graveyard.
D1 · replaces Currency Converter · tier 2 · $4.02 · A free sacrifice outlet turns every Spirit into damage. The deck makes bodies and currently has no way to cash them in.
D1 · replaces Lorehold Charm · tier 2 · $4.83 · Four damage, or team indestructible through a wipe, or double strike. Three answers on one card instead of one.
D1 · replaces Squee, the Immortal · tier 2 · $1.38 · Repeatable creature recursion every turn, and the token is exiled at end of turn so the card leaves the graveyard again.
D1 · replaces Perpetual Timepiece · tier 3 · $4.04 · Tutors any instant in the deck straight onto the stack. Consistency for a deck built on the right answer at the right time.
D1 · replaces Cathartic Reunion · tier 3 · $1.83 · Two permanents back at instant speed for two mana, and two cards leaving the graveyard means two Spirits.
D1 · replaces Thrilling Discovery · tier 3 · $1.55 · One mana of insurance against the wipe that otherwise ends your game.

decks.notes: Cards LEAVING your graveyard make 3/2 Spirits. Fill the bin, exile from it repeatedly, sac Spirits to free-cast what you exiled. Midrange grind. Win through recursion value and a wide Spirit alpha, not speed.

decks.name: D2 Chulane Value Loop

slots.notes: D2 · replaces Unbreakable Formation · tier 2 · $15.52 · Hexproof and indestructible at instant speed. Cut on second review in favour of Unbreakable Formation at $0.74.
D2 · replaces Approach of the Second Sun · tier 2 · $20.45 · Same-turn kill off either infinite loop. Cut on second review; Approach does it for a third of the price.
D2 · replaces Fblthp, the Lost · tier 1 · $17.33 · With Chulane out, two cheap creatures bounce each other forever. This is the card that turns the deck from good value into a combo deck.
D2 · replaces Farseek · tier 1 · $37.89 · Tutors any creature to the battlefield, and for large X it is the game-ending pump. One card that is both the setup and the finish.
D2 · replaces Satyr Wayfinder · tier 1 · $24.17 · Doubles every enter-the-battlefield trigger you have and shuts off every one your opponents have. In a deck built on ETBs this is two cards in one.
D2 · replaces Mistmeadow Witch · tier 2 · $13.56 · A blink outlet that costs three and needs no blue, and it grows the creature it blinks.
D2 · replaces Kami of Ancient Law · tier 2 · $15.17 · A card every time a nontoken creature enters. Chulane already draws you one; this doubles it.
D2 · replaces Freed from the Real · tier 2 · $32.38 · Blinks a nonland permanent every time you cast a noncreature spell. Free value on cards you were casting anyway.
D2 · replaces Reclamation Sage · tier 2 · $27.90 · The best card selection in green. Fixes the draws where Chulane never lands.
D2 · replaces Elvish Visionary · tier 3 · $9.00 · A card on every creature spell instead of a card once.
D2 · replaces Coiling Oracle · tier 3 · $2.20 · Two blinks for one card, and it can reset lands as well as creatures.

decks.notes: Every creature CAST draws a card and gives a land drop. Blink/bounce cheap ETB bodies to loop value. Combo-value. Ramp hard, land Chulane, chain creatures, finish wide or on a loop.

decks.name: D3 Atraxa Proliferate

slots.notes: D3 · replaces Fall of the First Civilization · tier 2 · $13.67 · One-sided -1/-1 wipe plus a second proliferate every turn. Cut on second review; Fall of the First Civilization does the wipe job free.
D3 · replaces Fuel for the Cause · tier 1 · $39.54 · Overloaded it bounces every nonland permanent your opponents control at instant speed. It is the single best turn this deck can have.

D3 · replaces Viral Drake · tier 1 · $33.36 · Doubles every counter you place and halves every counter your opponents get. Atraxa's proliferate becomes twice as fast and their proliferate stops working.
D3 · replaces Repel Calamity · tier 1 · $33.07 · The wipe answer the deck does not have. Phases out everything you own and makes you untargetable until your next turn.
D3 · replaces Tragic Arrogance · tier 1 · $11.11 · A one-sided wipe. Everything without a +1/+1 counter dies, and your board is made of +1/+1 counters.
D3 · replaces Valorous Stance · tier 2 · $15.52 · Two mana to save the entire board. The second layer of wipe insurance behind Teferi's Protection.
D3 · replaces Wall of Resurgence · tier 2 · $10.77 · A +1/+1 counter on every creature you control every time a creature enters. It compounds with every token and every proliferate.
D3 · replaces Plaguemaw Beast · tier 2 · $7.06 · Doubles the counters on every creature you control whenever it attacks.
D3 · replaces Guardian Scalelord · tier 2 · $7.75 · Every creature with a counter becomes unblockable. It turns a stalled counters board into lethal.
D3 · replaces Blight Rot · tier 3 · $9.00 · A card on every creature spell in the deck with the most creatures.
D3 · replaces Ichormoon Gauntlet · tier 3 · $0.92 · Doubles every counter that would be placed on your creatures for four mana.
D3 · replaces Steady Progress · tier 3 · $0.81 · Every creature you cast arrives with counters already on it. The Hexmage removes counters, which fights your own plan.
D3 · replaces Tezzeret's Gambit · tier 3 · $4.24 · One mana, and it gives a creature protection to dodge removal or to push damage through.

decks.notes: Free end-step proliferate compounds every counter. Win on poison, +1/+1 counters, or charge-counter engines. Four-colour grind. Survive, spread counters, let proliferate double them.

decks.name: D4 Felothar Walls

slots.notes: D4 · replaces Nyx-Fleece Ram · tier 2 · $8.44 · A fifth global toughness-as-damage body. Cut from the order on second review; the deck has four already.
D4 · replaces Canopy Gargantuan · tier 1 · $14.34 · All damage to your creatures becomes +1/+1 counters instead. In a toughness deck it makes combat unlosable.
D4 · replaces Weathered Sentinels · tier 1 · $15.52 · Two mana to protect the board you spent the game assembling.
